name: tauri-image-viewer
start:
if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:1420 >/dev/null; then exit 0; fi
npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 1420 >/tmp/vite-dev.log 2>&1 &
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:1420 >/dev/null; then exit 0; fi
  sleep 1
done
echo 'Vite failed to become ready on :1420' >&2
exit 1
